title: The REACH-OUT Trial
official: A Technology-based, Primary Care Strategy to Optimize Blood Pressure Before Pregnancy: The REACH-OUT Trial
summary: Test the effectiveness of a technology-enabled strategy to optimize blood pressure among reproductive-aged women with hypertension receiving care in Federally Qualified Health Centers.

interventions.name: BP monitor, brief orientation, and portal tools

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* biologically female
* age 18-44
* English or Spanish-speaking
* prescribed an antiHTN
* have a systolic BP \>140 or diastolic BP\>90 at their index visit
* have access to the internet

Exclusion Criteria:

* not pregnant or within 3 months postpartum
* severe, uncorrectable vision, hearing, or cognitive impairment that would preclude study consent or participation
